description: Render definitive full-consensus Lead AOP network with MIEs, AOs, and calcium/arrhythmia/ROS consensus edges highlighted
code:
import networkx as nx, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from collections import Counter

name = {177:"Mito dysfunction",1115:"ROS increase",1262:"Apoptosis",1339:"Ca2+ increase",2146:"MEK/ERK\n(MIE 499/500)",
 352:"Neurodegeneration",188:"Neuroinflammation",55:"Cell injury/death",201:"NMDAR antagonist\nbinding (MIE 12)",
 195:"NMDAR inhibition",52:"Decreased Ca2+ influx",381:"Reduced BDNF",2287:"Impaired Na-Ca exch.",
 389:"Ca2+ OVERLOAD\n(consensus +KE1339)",2289:"RyR2 hyperphos.",2292:"Altered conduction",
 1106:"Cardiac arrhythmia\n(AO)",1562:"Decr Na/K-ATPase\n(MIE 556)",1321:"Na+ increase",1532:"Decr contractility",
 1535:"Heart failure (AO)",2281:"Uncoord. contraction",2283:"Early prem. depol.",593:"ERG K+ inhib\n(MIE 555)",
 1961:"Prolonged APD",1962:"QT prolongation",698:"Altered AP",1963:"Torsades",2151:"Disrupted NT release",
 693:"cAMP increase",2290:"Funny-current inhib\n(MIE 560)",2291:"Slowed heart rate",341:"Learning/memory\nimpair (AO)",
 2288:"PDE inhib (MIE 558)",1529:"L-type Ca2+ block\n(MIE 552)"}

aop_edges = {
 500:[(177,1115),(1115,1262),(1339,1262),(2146,1339),(1339,177),(1262,352),(352,341)],
 499:[(2146,1339),(1339,2151),(2151,341)],
 12:[(352,188),(55,188),(201,195),(188,352),(195,52),(52,381),(381,55),(352,341)],
 556:[(2287,389),(1562,1321),(389,1532),(1532,1535),(1321,2287)],
 558:[(2289,389),(389,1532),(1532,1535),(693,2289),(2288,693)],
 552:[(2281,1535),(1963,2281),(698,1962),(1962,1963),(1529,698)],
 555:[(2283,1535),(593,1961),(1961,1962),(1962,2283)],
 560:[(2292,1106),(2290,2291),(2291,2292)]}
cluster={12:'neuro',499:'neuro',500:'neuro',552:'cardiac',555:'cardiac',556:'cardiac',558:'cardiac',560:'chrono'}
ccol={'neuro':'#4C72B0','cardiac':'#C44E52','chrono':'#55A868'}
node_cluster={}
for aop,edges in aop_edges.items():
    for u,v in edges:
        for n in (u,v): node_cluster.setdefault(n,Counter())[cluster[aop]]+=1
node_cluster={n:c.most_common(1)[0][0] for n,c in node_cluster.items()}

# consensus merges + edges
merge={1339:389}; rl=lambda u: merge.get(u,u)
G=nx.DiGraph()
for aop,edges in aop_edges.items():
    for u,v in edges: G.add_edge(rl(u),rl(v))
consensus_edges=[(2283,1106),(1963,1106),(1115,2289)]  # arrhythmia bridges + ROS->RyR2 bridge
for u,v in consensus_edges: G.add_edge(u,v)
node_cluster[389]='cardiac'
print("Final consensus: nodes",G.number_of_nodes(),"edges",G.number_of_edges(),"components",nx.number_weakly_connected_components(G))

AOs={341,1535,1106}; MIEs={201,2146,1529,593,1562,2288,2290}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(19,14))
pos=nx.spring_layout(G,k=1.35,iterations=500,seed=11)
ncols=[ccol[node_cluster.get(n,'cardiac')] for n in G.nodes()]
ec=['gold' if n in AOs else ('black' if n in MIEs else 'white') for n in G.nodes()]
lw=[3.5 if n in AOs else (2.5 if n in MIEs else 1) for n in G.nodes()]
nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G,pos,ax=ax,node_color=ncols,node_size=1700,edgecolors=ec,linewidths=lw)
reg=[e for e in G.edges() if e not in set(consensus_edges)]
nx.draw_networkx_edges(G,pos,ax=ax,edgelist=reg,arrows=True,arrowsize=15,edge_color='#999',width=1.3,node_size=1700)
nx.draw_networkx_edges(G,pos,ax=ax,edgelist=consensus_edges,arrows=True,arrowsize=22,edge_color='crimson',width=3,style='dashed',node_size=1700)
nx.draw_networkx_labels(G,pos,{n:name.get(n,str(n)) for n in G.nodes()},ax=ax,font_size=7)
ax.set_title("Lead (Pb) 8-AOP consensus network — unified via calcium hub, arrhythmia node & ROS bridge\n(single connected component, 34 KEs)",fontsize=14,fontweight='bold')
ax.axis('off')
leg=[mpatches.Patch(color=ccol['neuro'],label='Neurodevelopmental (AOP 12,499,500)'),
     mpatches.Patch(color=ccol['cardiac'],label='Cardiac contractility/EP (AOP 552,555,556,558)'),
     mpatches.Patch(color=ccol['chrono'],label='Chronotropic (AOP 560)'),
     mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white',edgecolor='gold',linewidth=3,label='Adverse Outcome'),
     mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white',edgecolor='black',linewidth=2.5,label='Molecular Initiating Event'),
     plt.Line2D([0],[0],color='crimson',lw=3,ls='--',label='Consensus KER added (calcium/arrhythmia/ROS)')]
ax.legend(handles=leg,loc='lower left',fontsize=10,framealpha=0.9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('lead_aop_final_consensus_network.png',dpi=130,bbox_inches='tight')
print("saved lead_aop_final_consensus_network.png")

# MIE summary
print("\n7 distinct MIEs across 8 AOPs:")
for k in [201,2146,1529,593,1562,2288,2290]:
    print(" KE",k,name[k].replace(chr(10),' '))
